name: clip
summary: 7 key moments: ready -> boxing guard stance -> right punch extended -> right cross extended -> right punch extended -> right cross extended -> right punch extended -> hands lowered (finish)
action: The body holds a standing stance while repeatedly extending the right arm outward and across with the left hand in guard before lowering both hands.

stages.name: boxing guard stance
stages.description: The body settles into a staggered stance while raising both hands to chest height.
stages.measured: right hand up, left hand up

stages.name: right punch extended
stages.description: The body holds its stance while extending the right arm out to the right with the left fist near the chest.

stages.name: right cross extended
stages.description: The body rotates slightly while driving the right arm across to the left with the left hand held near the chest.
stages.measured: right hand left, left hand right

stages.name: right punch extended
stages.description: The body rotates back while bringing the right arm out to the right again.
stages.measured: right hand right, left hand left

stages.name: right cross extended
stages.description: The body rotates again while driving the right arm across to the left.
stages.measured: right hand left, left hand right

stages.name: right punch extended
stages.description: The body rotates back while bringing the right arm out to the right again.
stages.measured: right hand right, left hand left

stages.name: hands lowered (finish)
stages.description: The body steps forward and turns left while lowering both hands from guard.

notes: Progress toward the next key moment pays as it happens, gated on staying upright.
Each key moment reached pays a bonus; a jump pays extra for its height.
Finishing pays a bonus scaled by the moments reached.
Once done, holding the end pose pays per second, and the style terms stop.
A fall gives back what the attempt earned since the last steady stance.
Timing is free: only the order of the moments counts.
Optional moments pay too, but may be skipped.
